supersedes: collective-consciousness wording that implies multiple persons
inter-Tom telepathy model based on separate minds

coreIdentity.personhood: one continuous subjective identity expressed across multiple physically separate bodies
coreIdentity.adultAppearance: elderly-looking through most of adult life
coreIdentity.hierarchy: none; no Tom is an executive, leader, queen, master brain, or privileged node
coreIdentity.canonicalMaxim: One life. Twelve bodies. Many places. Still me.

consciousness.autobiographicalMemory: continuous and shared by the one mind; no upload, synchronization, or later report is required
consciousness.distance: ordinary distance does not degrade identity or consciousness continuity
consciousness.physicalCoordination: improves when Toms are co-located even though identity does not become stronger
consciousness.parallelAttention: substantial but finite; multiple physical contexts can be attended simultaneously, but deep cognition remains one finite mind
consciousness.internalDisagreement: different Toms can voice or enact competing lines of thought without becoming separate people
principles: They divide attention; they do not divide identity.
Psychic cohesion does not degrade with ordinary distance; physical coordination does.
The ManyToms is wherever its Toms are.
Distribution expands access to information; concentration produces depth.

biology.genetics: genetically singular organism; a true DNA change initiated in one Tom propagates across the whole organism
biology.bodySpecialization: knowledge belongs to the singular mind; local muscle memory, conditioning, injury, scars, sensory adaptation, and reflex calibration can be Tom-specific
biology.aggregation: Toms can brace, climb, stack, chain, and form body-shaped masses; no emergent giant hands, feet, fused limbs, or larger anatomy is produced
biology.tomLoss: permanent bodily and neurological loss suffered by the same person; impairment becomes increasingly severe as complement falls
biology.death: the ManyToms dies only when the last surviving Tom dies
biology.lowComplementPersonhood: complete personhood remains regardless of surviving body count

sleep.wholeSleep: all surviving Toms sleep simultaneously, producing genuine unconsciousness

reproductionAndDevelopment.participation: only one Tom need be physically involved in reproduction while the singular mind experiences the event
reproductionAndDevelopment.gestation: external brooding cocoon based on a biological reproductive matrix
reproductionAndDevelopment.fertilization: many ova and many gametes are produced; normally one viable fertilization establishes, rarely two
reproductionAndDevelopment.twins: rare double establishment produces two separate ManyToms children, each developing its own twelve-Tim complement
reproductionAndDevelopment.developmentalRule: one embryo grows twelve bodies; it is not twelve embryos later linked
reproductionAndDevelopment.continuanceMilestone: the developing child's physically separate Tims remain one person after the last embryonic physical connection disappears
reproductionAndDevelopment.firstSeparation: major childhood milestone demonstrating that self is not singular location
reproductionAndDevelopment.adulthood: associated with mastery of attention, separation, self-care, and body stewardship as Tims become colloquially Toms or Tams

homeworld.name: Thomara
homeworld.environment: warm, old world dominated by interconnected wetland forests, braided rivers, root systems, elevated living platforms, islands, flooded lowlands, and dense vertical ecosystems

twelveDivider.status: descended from the four-divider branch; includes ManyToms

twentyFourDivider.status: extinct; descended from twelve-divider stock; fossil record includes highly effective predators

homeworld.firstSilence: philosophical name for the deep-time extinction of the 24-divider lineages
homeworld.protoSapienceQuestion: whether any 24-divider lineage approached proto-sapience remains deliberately unresolved

severanceWars.coreTrauma: weaponized disruption of distributed identity and pathological partition of one person
legalLegacy: identity integrity is a fundamental right
a separated Tom remains the person
pathological partition does not create new legal citizens
Tom loss never reduces civic personhood

greatDistribution.benefit: routine long-distance bodily distribution transformed work, family, education, cities, and government
greatDistribution.failureMode: society confused plural bodies with limitless cognition

tomBombCrisis.category: terrorist genetic serum weaponization exploiting genetic singularity
modernLegacy: strong bodily-consent norms around injectors and medical devices

threeWoundsOfContinuance: Severance: the self can be attacked by forcing it apart.
Overreach: the self can damage itself by trying to be everywhere.
Corruption: the self's own unity can be turned against it.

culture.everydayDistribution: normal in ManyToms-majority society; keeping all twelve bodies together all day is usually inefficient
culture.adventuringDistribution: adventurers usually keep the complement gathered because danger, unfamiliar environments, and limited support reward local concentration
attentionEtiquette: I have one ear with you: casual attention.
I am turning toward you: increasing concentration.
I am gathering: withdrawing attention from elsewhere.
I am all with you: near-total attention.
culture.personalSpace: self-contact among a person's Toms is not interpersonal contact; touching another person remains governed by ordinary consent
culture.personMarkers: shared visual identity motifs distinguish which Toms belong to one ManyToms; body-specific identifiers may coexist
culture.cuisine: designed partly around simultaneous flavor contrast across several mouths
culture.courtship: chosen repeated presence is meaningful; full gathering is intimate
culture.marriage: one ManyToms is one spouse; full gathering commonly carries ceremonial weight
culture.parenting: one child occupies twelve Tims; parents must teach distribution, attention, and body stewardship
culture.falsePartitionTaboo: deliberately treating Toms as separate people for advantage is morally and legally repugnant
characteristicInsultsOrWarnings: You would sever to be right.

higherEducation.model: distributed laboratory, archive, fieldwork, apprenticeship, clinical, and workshop networks rather than lecture-centered campuses
higherEducation.advantage: one student can occupy several evidence contexts while one mind compares them in real time
higherEducation.attentionArchitecture: students learn when to distribute and when deep work requires gathering
higherEducation.scheduling: courses track both body allocation and cognitive demand
higherEducation.libraries: optimized for parallel comparison, source triangulation, and several simultaneous research stations
higherEducation.apprenticeship: shared intellectual learning can coexist with Tom-specific embodied motor specialization
higherEducation.graduateStudy: advanced scholarship is judged by integration across distributed evidence
higherEducation.academicIntegrity: all Toms belong to the same test-taker; leaving one Tom with forbidden sources is ordinary cheating
higherEducation.oneMindPrinciple: Many eyes broaden evidence. Many minds broaden possibility.

institutions.government: one person, one civic identity; body count does not multiply votes, citizenship, taxes, marriages, or contracts
institutions.jurisdiction: the act has a location; the person may not
institutions.custody: serious physical custody can require a heavily regulated gathering order
institutions.gatheredResponsibility: important roles may require sufficient cognitive concentration; divided attention is not always an excuse
institutions.labor: body-capacity, attention demand, and cognitive labor are separate concepts; one ManyToms is not twelve full workers
institutions.medicine: distinguishes Tom-scale treatment from whole-person distributed neurological and genetic treatment

materialCulture.architecture: dense circulation networks with numerous small entrances, grip rails, ladders, crawl routes, balconies, vertical shortcuts, and many access points
materialCulture.furniture: modular rest sets plus secure whole-sleep spaces
materialCulture.heavyWork: many small grips, levers, pulleys, counterweights, ramps, harnesses, and distributed-load systems
materialCulture.computing: distributed interface environments recognizing several simultaneous bodies as one authorized user
materialCulture.transit: counts people and bodies separately; fares and legal identity generally follow persons while physical capacity follows bodies
materialCulture.vehicleUse: ordinary civilians often move only part of the complement; full-complement transport is common in dangerous expeditions

religiousTraditions.unbrokenBetween: the person participates in a real underlying psychic Between; twelve bodies are anchors, not twelve souls
religiousTraditions.livingPattern: the ManyToms is the continuously integrated pattern; capacity and identity are distinct
religiousTraditions.concordanceOfFleshAndBetween: personhood arises from a stable relationship between embodied neural organization and a real psychic substrate
religiousTraditions.wayOfReturning: healthy life moves outward and returns; distribution and gathering are both necessary practices
religiousTraditions.witnessOfTwentyFour: 24-divider fossils teach humility about what biology makes possible; twelve is not cosmically inevitable

philosophicalSchools.continuityDoctrine: personhood follows continuous subjective identity, not body count, location, physical configuration, or disability
philosophicalSchools.goodPlacement: attention is an ethical resource; the question is where to be and how much of oneself a moment deserves
philosophicalSchools.preservedDissent: serious objections should survive decisions strongly enough for future people to evaluate them intelligently
philosophicalSchools.oneMindPrinciple: multiple bodily viewpoints do not create multiple independent minds
philosophicalSchools.gatheredResponsibility: serious responsibilities can require deliberate concentration of attention

rites: adult transition from Tim to Tom/Tam
bodyLossRite: Something of you is permanently gone.
ritesAndMourning.finalFuneral: only occurs after the last Tom dies; it is the first death rite at which the ManyToms is not present

militaryAndAdventure.doctrine: one tactical mind distributed across multiple positions; preferred formation is a web rather than a cluster
militaryAndAdventure.casualtyPrinciple: Tom casualties are permanent neurological injuries to the same soldier and are not treated as expendable subordinates
militaryAndAdventure.coreLimitation: one finite mind; distribution creates physical options, not twelve independent full-intellect turns

openCanonQuestions: native-language names for the major religious and philosophical traditions
specific taxonomy of non-sapient divider species
definitive scientific explanation of the distributed consciousness substrate
exact game-mechanical implementation of parallel attention, distributed inventory, Tom loss, and gathering
detailed named modern states, cities, universities, temples, and political parties
